source_row.rationale: Doxycycline and other tetracycline-class antibiotics carry a risk of photosensitivity, an increased sensitivity to sunlight that can cause exaggerated sunburn reactions, requiring clients to use sun protection and avoid prolonged sun exposure during treatment.
